insights.one_liner: Anthony Veder is a Rotterdam shipping company running gas tankers for LPG, LNG and petrochemical gases, and an IND visa sponsor.

culture.text: Around 488 people on LinkedIn; many studied maritime studies, marine engineering or economics at schools like Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences and TU Delft.
Staff come from maritime academies in Indonesia, Ukraine and Latvia as well, so the crew and team are international.
Its one open role here is a mid-level operations and supply chain job in Rotterdam.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Anthony Veder Rederijzaken B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: A Dutch shipping company founded in 1937, owned by Anthony Veder Group N.V.
Says it was first with LNG-fuelled fast-cooling ethylene carriers and pioneered small-scale LNG shipping and bunkering.
